variations.title: Variation 1
method: Crush the solid asafoetida and fry it in oil, then remove it.
Place another pan on the stove and first roast the pepper lightly.
Immediately add toor dal. Once that is lightly roasted, add the pinched red chilies (keep them pinched and ready beforehand).
Add the coriander seeds. After that, add curry leaves... then finally add cumin and roast.
Add the fried asafoetida to the roasted mixture.
Grind this mixture in a mixer or mill, then mix in the turmeric powder well.
**Note:** For four cups of tomato rasam or dal rasam, adding 1.5 tsp of this powder is enough. No need to add asafoetida separately when making the rasam.

variations.title: Variation 2
method: Sun-dry all the ingredients and then grind them into a powder.
